# Globule Damacy: one rolling sampler with Record and Play on the same page.
copy+require	src/instruments/globule-damacy/model.js

copy+require	docs/globule-damacy.md

**[Globule Damacy](globule-damacy.html)** is a work-in-progress rolling sampler:
Record and Play are two sections of **one instrument**. Roll a fixed-size
chrome marble across eight straight audio waves on a black floor. Both axes
turn freely; collected grains stick as independent waveform marks, including
at the poles. With Audio on, pickups sound as they stick. The fixed bendy-straw
needle later plays grain zones as the marble rolls beneath it; bare chrome
stays quiet. Needle width, top-layer transparency, fixed or random grain size,
Record/Play presets, original generated sounds, local audio files and mic takes
make a sample collage.
[Controls, privacy and limits](docs/globule-damacy.md).

sharedChanges.addition:
## Globule Damacy

`globule-damacy.webp` is an original 512 × 512 procedural marbled-glass sphere
in pink, lilac, cyan and gold lacquer, covered in scattered, independent grain
zones beneath a contact needle, generated by
`scripts/generate-globule-damacy-icon.py` using Pillow. It has no game imagery,
third-party samples, photography, or external image.
